articles.executive_summary: Chainalysis discloses data breach from "offensive agentic techniques". Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis disclosed a data breach after attackers used "offensive agentic techniques" to access internal systems and tools, exposing customer names, email addresses, user IDs, and organizational roles.
